files.name: motion-prompt-028.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Zoom in" (ズームイン), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #028

What it is: Magnify with the lens (camera stays put)
What the sample shows: The camera does not move; only the focal length gets longer, so the whole picture enlarges by the same ratio.
Spec:
- Camera: position and direction fixed (height 1.5 m); only the focal length changes, 330 px → 1200 px (shown as 24mm → 87mm, about 3.6×)
- Exponential interpolation: f = 330 × (8/2.2)^p, where p is a cubic ease-in-out from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s)
- Subject: a person stands still 8 m ahead; the final size matches 03 Dolly in (about 3.6×)
- No parallax: the foreground post and rock, the person, buildings and mountains all scale by the same ratio (overlaps do not change)
- Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
- Top-right readout shows the focal length in mm (24mm → 87mm)
When to use it: To direct attention to one point without moving the camera; it looks flatter and more observational than a dolly in.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/028.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
